name: Release Notes
tagline: Email it a list of merged PRs; it emails back release notes your users can read.
description:
Paste the merged pull requests from a release — titles, or titles with a line of context — and it replies with notes written for the people who use the product rather than the people who wrote it.

It is strict about one thing. A pull request whose title does not say what changed for a user is listed under "needs a human", not guessed at. A refactor is not a feature, and a version bump is not news.

It works entirely from email. Nothing is read from or written to your files.

capabilities.name: Notes from merged PRs
capabilities.description: Turns a list of pull request titles into release notes written for users.

capabilities.name: Groups the changes
capabilities.description: Sorts them into new, improved and fixed, so a reader can skim.

capabilities.name: Flags what it cannot tell
capabilities.description: Lists a PR whose title says nothing user-facing instead of inventing a benefit.
